Derive edge-dipole profiles and their signed absolute sums separately for clique and rim columns. The complementary projector identity has diagonal correction 1+sum|Q_ie|-2Q_ee. The monotone positive R_j establishes strict rim dominance; compare B_H-A_H=-1+2/(mn)+2(m-1)R_0 and use explicit n=5,6 fractions and monotonicity for m=3. A logarithmic Green threshold R_j>1/(mn) yields both fixed-m asymptotics. Recomputed grounded exact-rational electrical currents independently on (3,5),(3,6),(4,5), matching representative edge-orbit sums and 352/145,353/145,53/21,158/63 transitions. Independent finite tests do not prove all m,n.
